It ties in to Jackson's [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series [[Star Wars: Knight Errant (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knight Errant'' comic series]], and it was first published on [[January 25]], [[2011]] by [[Del Rey]]. The novel is set in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], and it follows the events of [[Star Wars: Knight Errant: Aflame|''Aflame'']], the comic book series' first story arc.
